title: Two limit cycles for quintic Liénard systems
summary: Every classical Liénard system $`\dot x=y-F(x)`$, $`\dot y=-x`$, with F an arbitrary real polynomial of degree at most five, has at most two geometrically distinct isolated periodic orbits, and the bound is attained. This proves the degree-five case of the Lins Neto–de Melo–Pugh conjecture.
family_title: Hilbert's sixteenth problem: uniform bounds for limit cycles

review.reason: Proves an upper bound on limit cycles for degree-five Liénard systems, addressing a known conjecture.
